hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: UI chrome is deliberately designed (clean card layout, consistent blue accent, clear typographic hierarchy, muted #476376 edge color), but the 900×900 SVG overflows the viewport and crops the visualization — a concrete layout bug — and the Tableau10 palette, while decent, is still off-the-shelf.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout node sizing (area encoding) and sunburst radial scale, key functions present on node and link joins, data-driven radiusScale domain — minor robustness gap from missing key function on hierarchyLinkSelection (.data(root.links()) with no key) and hardcoded layout dimensions, but no false baselines or lie-factor violations since this is a topology explorer rather than a quantitative magnitude chart.
flags: Update Storm: tension-slider calls redrawLinks() on every input event with no debounce or RAF, mutating up to 300 link path attributes per tick

Mid-Flight Snap: no explicit .interrupt() on nodeSelection before new transitions; force simulation starts immediately via runForceSimulation() while the 750ms shape-morph attrTween is still in flight on the same nodes
Mouse-Touch Fight: mousedown/click handlers have no touch-event filtering (no event.sourceEvent guard, no event.preventDefault()), risking ghost double-triggers on mobile
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The tension slider drives an un-throttled O(300) DOM redraw on every mousemove, the force layout races its own shape-morph transition, and there is no touch-vs-mouse discrimination—three distinct robustness violations against an otherwise clean dispatcher (no infinite-loop risk, no stale-scale closures).
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 300 simultaneous edge bundles at low tension (8%) create a near-hairball mass at the circle pack center that is unreadable in the default state — the highlight/fade interaction rescues legibility but can't be evaluated from a static screenshot, and the dense control panel (8 layout buttons, tension slider, 4 checkboxes, easing select, FPS display) adds its own working memory overhead before the viewer even engages with the data.
